text:
Alex Kim: Quick sync with @Marcus from ZenCompute — we need actual supply curves for 3/6/12m commit tenors and the transient spot 'shelf life' behavior. Can you drop a CSV sample + short notes? Thinking about how to model decay in available hours over time. tl;dr: per-region, per-sku monthly expected available hours + price tiers. Thanks! :pray:

Marcus (ZenCompute): Hey Alex — sure. We can provide a CSV. One note: 'shelf life' depends on maintenance windows and forecasted demand; we'll include an eviction_rate column and a weekday/weekend split. Sample below.

Marcus (ZenCompute): ```
sku,region,tenor_months,price_per_gpu_hour_usd,avg_monthly_hours,eviction_rate_pct,spot_floor_usd,marketplace_fee_pct
A100-40G,us-west-2,1,2.10,480,1.8,0.50,0
A100-40G,us-west-2,3,1.85,1300,1.2,0.45,0
A100-80G,eu-central-1,12,1.15,3600,0.6,0.35,5
V100-16G,us-east-1,6,1.50,1800,0.9,0.40,0
```

Priya Shah: Thanks. Quick q — are price_per_gpu_hour_usd for reserved incl. any volume discounts or is that the base committed rate? What's the commit cliff and how do we model mid-tenor adjustments? Also what's the SLA for eviction notifications (webhooks?)

Marcus (ZenCompute): price_per_gpu_hour_usd in the CSV is the base committed rate. We apply tiered rebates off that (post-invoice) for >10k GPU-hours/month. Commit cliff is 7 days before the reserved period starts; mid-tenor price changes are rare but we publish amendment windows 30/7/1 days before. Eviction notifications: we support webhooks with 3-tier notices (24h, 1h, 10m) depending on planned vs forced.

Tom B: For modeling, we need effective blended cost for mixed reserved/spot usage. Can you include typical hourly fill % by region (spot as percent of remaining fleet) — e.g., hour-of-day series so we can weight latency-sensitive routing?

Marcus (ZenCompute): Sure — we'll add an hourly_fill_pct CSV. Quick example here: ```
region,hour,spot_fill_pct
us-west-2,00,60
us-west-2,06,68
us-west-2,12,82
us-west-2,18,74
eu-central-1,00,55
eu-central-1,12,78
```

Lia Chen: Also please include a sample invoice stub and call out whether marketplace listing fees apply (AWS/Azure/GCP). We need to model net-of-marketplace for customers using marketplace procurement.

Marcus (ZenCompute): For marketplace: 5% listing fee applies to reserved SKUs on AWS Marketplace in eu-central-1; other clouds depend on channel (we'll flag per SKU). Invoice stub + webhook spec ETA EOD.

Priya Shah: One more ask — can you include an "eviction_profile" column that is a small enum (planned, short_notice, forced) so we can weight risk differently in our cost simulations?

Marcus (ZenCompute): Good call. We'll add eviction_profile and also include expected mean-time-to-recover (minutes) per profile.

Alex Kim: Awesome. Action items: Marcus to drop full CSV, hourly_fill_pct, invoice stub, and webhook spec; Marcus ETA EOD today. Priya to run a quick model with baseline eviction_rate 1.5% and eviction_profile weighting; Tom to compute blended reserved/spot cost per region using sample hourly_fill_pct; Lia to confirm marketplace fee handling in revenue share model. Reconvene Friday 10am PT to review. :calendar: :thumbsup:
